pipeline.selection: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.
pipeline.fits: Reuse unchanged pinned production controls. Fit every neural crop selected by the new fixed model, retaining all 32 photos, unresolved crops and failed fits. Compare with saved audited decoder-only outputs without selecting checkpoints or methods per photo.
pipeline.validation: Independent exported weave error <=3%, original feature checks, geometry/paper checks, production editable conversion and independent editable-paper audit. Visual review of all photos/crops and distinct outputs.
pipeline.missing: No manual rescue or result-dependent replacement. Record photo eligibility misclassifications and possible irregular weaving separately without removing them from primary denominators.

scope: Fixed-budget outline-supervision experiment on the same 24 reviewed training photos. Same fresh publisher initialization, 180 draws, synthetic data, optimizer, late-encoder adaptation, normalization and final checkpoint as the saved encoder model. Only an explicit known-outline auxiliary loss is added. Additional loss computation means this is not an exactly equal-compute trial. Training-band metrics are diagnostic and do not establish crop or reconstruction improvement. Native development only; no browser parity or production-release claim.
